messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to release/2026-03-23 blocked: ci-staging pipeline failed during artifact restore (cache restore checksum mismatch). Holding auto-promo. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345

mike: omg. which artifact? :eyes:

deploy-bot: wheel artifact: redwood_core-1.4.2-py3-none-any.whl. Expected sha256 9f2a... got 7d3b...
jane: can someone paste the last few lines of the fetch logs?

mike: logs https://ci.internal/runs/12345/logs -> snippet:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood_core-1.4.2.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=9f2a... actual=7d3b...
backend returned truncated object
```

sre-jen: this looks like mirror replication truncated object. Could be a multipart upload that didn't finalize. Two quick choices: 1) manual reupload to mirror (fast, but we need to be sure content ok) 2) pin release to last-good artifact digest and continue promo (safer during change window).

lucy: change window ends in 40m. I'd prefer pin+promote then follow-up with a rebuild + reupload, otherwise we risk delaying customers.

jane: agree. what's the last-good digest? mike, can you fetch from prod-mirror metadata?

mike: grabbed it: last-good sha256 = 9f2a1c4b... available at s3://prod-mirror/redwood_core/1.4.2/sha256.txt

sre-jen: If we pin, we should add a rollback doc and file an incident ticket to investigate mirror integrity and the uploader job. Also add an eval to verify package contents match source.

mike: command to pin (dry-run):
```bash
# pin to known-good digest and force promote
deploybot promote --release release/2026-03-23 --artifact redwood_core==1.4.2 --digest 9f2a1c4b --force-pin
```

jane: please run with --dry-run first, then run promote if output looks good. Mike, can you run and post results?

mike: ran dry-run -> looks clean, no schema mismatches. Kicking real promote now.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 9f2a1c4b. Auto-promo resumed. Change window unaffected. Promo completes.

lucy: great. created incident INC-2026-114 to track mirror truncation + uploader job. Assigned to infra-team. Added note to release notes: "Pinned redwood_core 1.4.2 to last-good artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; follow-up rebuild scheduled."

jane: :thumbsup: thanks all. mike — keep us posted on uploader fix and whether any other packages show similar issues.

mike: will do, starting a pass over recent uploads. Posting findings in #eng-infra later.

sre-jen: marking thread resolved from release standpoint. Leave incident open for root cause.
thread_text: Promotion blocked by cache restore checksum mismatch; pinned to last-good digest and promoted.
